extraction.name: WebWalkerQA
extraction.description: A benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal. It evaluates the capacity of LLMs to traverse a website’s subpages to extract high-quality data systematically.
extraction.creator: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang, Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang
extraction.rai:dataCollection: A two-stage funnel annotation strategy combining LLM-based and human annotation. GPT-4o performs initial annotations by traversing official websites recursively, followed by crowd-sourced human annotators conducting quality control and filtering.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Root official websites across conference, organization, education, and game domains.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Verify and filter for legitimate queries that deviate from natural, human-like phrasing, retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Verification and filtering of legitimate queries that deviate from natural phrasing, retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Human annotators rewrite and calibrate the synthetic questions and answers generated by the LLM to ensure correctness and consistency.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Human annotators conduct quality control and filtering to refine the final results, and can rewrite and calibrate the questions and answers to ensure the QA pairs are correct and consistent.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Due to varying lengths of generated text, exact match evaluation is challenging.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating LLMs on their ability to handle queries embedded in complex, multi-step web interactions on a given root website.

name.evidence: we introduce WebWalkerQA , a benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal.

description.evidence: we introduce WebWalkerQA , a benchmark designed to assess the ability of LLMs to perform web traversal. It evaluates the capacity of LLMs to traverse a website’s subpages to extract high-quality data systematically.

creator.evidence: Jialong Wu, Wenbiao Yin, Yong Jiang(  ), Zhenglin Wang, Zekun Xi, Runnan Fang, Linhai Zhang, Yulan He, Deyu Zhou, Pengjun Xie, Fei Huang

inLanguage.evidence: WebWalkerQA is a bilingual dataset that includes both Chinese and English

rai:dataCollection.evidence: To make the annotation process cost-efficient and accurate, we employ a two-stage funnel annotation strategy, combining LLM-based and human annotation. In the first stage, GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2022b), performs initial annotations, followed by a second stage, where crowd-sourced human annotators conduct quality control and filtering to refine the final results.

rai:dataCollectionType.evidence: Traverse official websites recursively, collecting information on accessible sub-links and their respective pages... crowd-sourced human annotators conduct quality control and filtering to refine the final results.

rai:dataCollectionRawData.evidence: We first collect root official websites across conference, organization, education, and game domains. Then we mimic human behavior by systematically clicking and collecting subpages accessible through sublinks on the root page.

rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol.evidence: Step3 : Verify and filter for legitimate queries that deviate from natural, human-like phrasing, retaining only QA pairs with short answers containing entities.

rai:dataAnnotationProtocol.evidence: After the synthetic queries are generated by LLM, human annotators can rewrite and calibrate the questions and answers to ensure the QA pairs are correct and consistent.

rai:machineAnnotationTools.evidence: In the first stage, GPT-4o (OpenAI, 2022b), performs initial annotations

rai:dataLimitations.evidence: Due to the varying lengths of generated text, it is challenging to perform exact match evaluation, even though we have controlled for short answers.

rai:dataUseCases.evidence: We propose WebWalkerQA , designed specifically to evaluate LLMs on their ability to handle queries embedded in complex, multi-step web interactions on a given root website.
